name: DRAM 3711
title: Advanced Study of Acting and Directing
description: While focusing on the creative process of actors and directors working together, students will engage in practical exercises, collaborative projects, and critical reflection. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: DRAM 1701, DRAM 1710, or DRAM 1711; open to Dramatic Arts majors and minors; others by instructor consent. Recommended preparation: DRAM 2141.
